text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The apple-flavored ice cream I stored in
the
refrigerator to cool down and
replenish my
energy has completely
melted.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...The refrigerator is silent. No
operational sounds
detected. I have
concluded that it is
malfunctioning.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Action must be taken in times of
dormitory
trouble. Shifting priorities to
report to dorm
leader.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My energy levels are low, so I will
attempt to call
the dorm leader using a
telecommunication
device.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Third instance this week of a
telecommunication
device breaking
down confirmed.

The repeated technical problems of all
the
electronics around her causes
Bourbon to become
both physically and
mentally exhausted.
